title: M5 stage18: subset events equal factor-product divisibility
scope: Section 3 bridge from finite factor exclusion subsets to F times their product; no polynomial Mobius sum acceptance

spec.name: M5.FactorProduct.distinct_irreducibles_coprime
spec.statement: ∀ p q : M5.BinaryPolynomial, p.Monic → q.Monic → Irreducible p → Irreducible q → p ≠ q → IsCoprime p q
spec.guidance: Irreducible.coprime_iff_not_dvd reduces to no divisibility. A divisor of irreducible q is a unit or associated to q; irreducibility rules out the unit case. Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_associated makes associated monic p,q equal. No assumption on a cyclic modulus. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.FactorProduct.irreducible_product_dvd
spec.statement: ∀ (S : Finset M5.BinaryPolynomial) (A : M5.BinaryPolynomial), (∀ p ∈ S, p.Monic ∧ Irreducible p) → ((∏ p ∈ S, p) ∣ A ↔ ∀ p ∈ S, p ∣ A)
spec.guidance: Forward each p divides the product via Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem. Reverse Finset.prod_dvd_of_coprime with pairwise coprimality obtained from distinct_irreducibles_coprime. Empty S and A=0 included. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.FactorProduct.common_factor_dvd
spec.statement: ∀ F H A : M5.BinaryPolynomial, F ≠ 0 → F ∣ A → (F * H ∣ A ↔ H ∣ A / F)
spec.guidance: Use EuclideanDomain.dvd_div_of_mul_dvd in one direction; use EuclideanDomain.mul_div_cancel' to reconstruct A from F*(A/F) in the reverse. A may be zero and F may share factors with H. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.FactorProduct.product_event_iff
spec.statement: ∀ (S : Finset M5.BinaryPolynomial) (F A : M5.BinaryPolynomial), F ≠ 0 → F ∣ A → (∀ p ∈ S, p.Monic ∧ Irreducible p) → (F * (∏ p ∈ S, p) ∣ A ↔ ∀ p ∈ S, F * p ∣ A)
spec.guidance: Apply common_factor_dvd to the product and to every individual factor, then irreducible_product_dvd to A/F. Preserve every multiplicity already contained in F. Do not assume F coprime to S or F squarefree. F|A is needed in the empty subset case. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.FactorProduct.cyclic_cap
spec.statement: ∀ (S : Finset M5.BinaryPolynomial) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (N : ℕ), 0 < N → F.Monic → F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N → S ⊆ M5.FactorProduct.residualFactors (M5.cyclicModulus N) F → F * (∏ p ∈ S, p) ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N
spec.guidance: Membership in normalizedFactors gives irreducibility and divisibility of M_N/F. Each irreducible binary polynomial is monic using imported M5.Signature.binary_monic and irreducible.ne_zero. Apply irreducible_product_dvd and common_factor_dvd. Repeated cyclic factors are retained in F and quotient; S picks each distinct remaining prime at most once, without assuming squarefreeness of F or M_N. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve exact target.
